briefs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a professional landscape 16:9 game environment concept board for UMBRAL, an original first-person retro 2.5D horde shooter. Create one beautifully composed concept sheet, crisp large detailed image. Title exact Spanish: "UMBRAL / CUENCA DE OBSIDIANA"; smaller subtitle "Adaptación vertical". Reference image is ONLY an architectural/material reference: maintain its volcanic stone, Mexican funerary stepped-temple architecture, skull friezes, ochre walkable floors, dark obsidian, red dusk sky. Redesign the view for the ACTUAL arena described here. No guns, no HUD, no photorealistic people.
Layout of board: about 70% left a large slightly elevated diagonal atmospheric environment illustration; 30% right a clean legible top-down concept floorplan on dark charcoal, aligned north up with entrance at bottom. The exact SAME major geometry in both views. A thin bottom legend with exact labels "Ruta", "Sello", "Llegada", "Peligro". Use fine amber route lines, restrained cyan discs for jump pads, cyan dashed arc arrows for launches, pale outlined square landing zones; red hatched danger areas. Tiny labels at most A, B, C, D in plan, minimal other text.
Playable geometry: rectangular courtyard 70 by 60 approximate world metres. Broad floor level 0, wide left/right terraces and rear terrace at +3, ONE east-west raised bridge at +6 behind the courtyard midpoint, connected to terraces by ramps at both ends, with a genuine open walking passage beneath it. FOUR tall square BLOOD-WATERFALL pillars exactly, two in front of bridge and two behind, flat crowns +6.4 with tiny enemy portal silhouettes, clear wide floor around each. Preserve central rear skull gateway, four lower access ramps, south entrance. Main floor is large enough for circular strafing and crossing left/right routes. Add FOUR cyan jump seals exactly: A,B on left/right ground near southern ramps launching onto left/right terraces; C,D on rear left/right terraces launching onto respective ends of bridge. Landing patches are broad and separated from spawn portals, with two onward exits and half-height cover beside not on them. Black sharp obsidian ammo stones, amber small-ammo crates and teal large-ammo crates distributed on separate routes, very sparingly. One small quadruped basalt stalker climbing a terrace and one small bone-framed ash weaver behind a rear colonnade give scale, not character portraits. Blood flows down pillar faces with readable red narrow strips, not flooded ground. Retro textured low-poly geometry, chunky pixel surface details, architectural concept art with good gameplay readability, high silhouette contrast, no fog obscuring routes. It must feel achievable in a lightweight browser Doom-like game. No unrelated medieval castles, no gothic spires, no excessive vegetation, no decorative unreadable pseudo-text.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original professional landscape 16:9 game environment concept board for UMBRAL, a first-person retro 2.5D horde shooter. Title exact Spanish: "UMBRAL / LAS FAUCES DE PIEDRA"; smaller subtitle "Arena de trituración". Match reference ONLY for the volcanic stone materials, textured retro 3D feel, funerary Mexican stepped architecture, skull carvings and clear playable surfaces. Invent the following DIFFERENT arena layout; do not copy the reference courtyard.
Board layout: about 70% left a large dramatic elevated diagonal environment view, 30% right a readable top-down conceptual floorplan on dark charcoal showing the exact same geometry. A thin bottom legend labels "Ruta", "Sello", "Llegada", "Peligro". Amber main-route lines on plan, cyan discs jump pads, dashed cyan arrows launch trajectories, white outline square landings, red hatch crushing zones. Keep text minimal, at most letter markers.
Two broad courtyard combat bowls side by side, left and right, separated by a tall central rock spine. THREE parallel east-west connecting passages through the spine, at front, middle and back. A broad continuous outer perimeter bypass ensures both yards remain reachable. An elevated traversal gallery +4 m crosses above the middle crusher corridor, with generous ramps ascending at opposite ends. One jump seal per courtyard (TWO TOTAL) launches onto its corresponding landing on that upper gallery. Include flank cover and two exits for each landing. Depict middle passage containing TWO enormous stone jaw blocks closing toward each other; side passages stay open, amber warning floor strips become red in the active middle pinch zone. Indicate the single dangerous crossing, do not block all routes. Mountains shaped like serrated obsidian teeth lean in above the architecture; background colossal mountains colliding, distant dust lit from behind, warm dusty ochre and rust rather than the reference's red sky. Broad arena lanes, limited sturdy cover, surface ramps rather than tiny stairs, real space underneath gallery. Matte grey basalt, eroded cinnabar plaster, skeletal glyph lintels, modest candle lights. A tiny quadruped black-orange basalt stalker on flank and a small masked skeletal ash weaver behind a pillar. Resource pickups split between two yards: angular black obsidian shards, amber ammo and teal ammo, optional richer pickup near risky crusher. Clearly retro chunky texels, simple strong geometry; atmospheric yet visually readable and feasible as a browser shooter. No gun, no HUD, no modern sci-fi jump platform machinery, no medieval castles, no illegible paragraphs.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original professional landscape 16:9 game environment concept board for UMBRAL, a first-person retro 2.5D horde shooter. Title exact Spanish: "UMBRAL / EL RÍO DE LAS ÁNIMAS"; smaller subtitle "Arena de crecidas". Reference image is ONLY a style/material guide for Mexican funerary stepped architecture, stone textures and retro polygon art. Make this arena distinctly aquatic and green-black, do not copy the reference layout.
Board composition 70% large elevated diagonal environment illustration at left, 30% readable top-down concept floorplan at right on charcoal background. Both show same topology. Bottom legend only "Ruta", "Sello", "Llegada", "Peligro". Main routes amber, cyan disc jump seals and dashed launch arrows, white outline landing rectangles, red hatch flooded lower path segments.
A broad central temple island with low altar, three large outer temple districts around it arranged approximately triangularly, all three connected in a CONTINUOUS outer ring by wide stone causeways. Three spokes of broad bridges connect the outer districts to the central island. Walkways high +3 m stay dry. Lower embankment paths at 0 m follow parts of the river banks, accessed with broad ramps; the black river rises slowly to cover only these lower segments. Waterline etched amber measuring glyphs and foam identify warning. Two paired jump seals, FOUR DISCS TOTAL, provide optional one-way arcs from one outer district to another, crossing open water rather than narrowing core bridges. Dry spacious landing courts adjacent to cover, separated from enemy arrival portals, each with at least two onward routes. Include clearly visible stairs/ramps out of the shallow flooded lanes. Huge slow black river exits via distant waterfalls between collapsed funerary towers and dark chasms. Bone-white carved statues, wet greenish basalt, dirty turquoise patina, restrained warm amber torches, dark olive water reflections; avoid luminous green water that could mask hostile projectiles. Visible rain ripples and curtains of distant water, no heavy fog. Sparse resource caches: obsidian stones on optional low paths and dry alternatives, amber/teal ammo in separate districts, health at center exposed altar. Tiny silhouettes of enemies on dry bridgeheads, one basalt stalker using an outer bank and one bone-framed ash weaver whose threads break behind large statues. Low-poly 1990s Doom/Hexen influenced textured geometry with carefully drawn chunky pixel surfaces, ambitious original environment composition but feasible light browser game. No gun, no HUD, no photorealism, no gothic European castle, no unreadable extra words.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original professional landscape 16:9 game environment concept board for UMBRAL, a first-person retro 2.5D horde shooter. Title exact Spanish: "UMBRAL / LA CORONA DEL VIENTO"; smaller subtitle "Arena de ascenso". Reference image ONLY guides Mexican funerary stone architecture, skull friezes, retro textured low-poly craft. This NEW layout is distinctly vertical, violet and blue-grey, not a recolored courtyard.
Board composition: 70% large aerial oblique cutaway environment view at left with unobstructed visibility into all elevations, 30% carefully readable simplified overhead floorplan on dark charcoal at right. Bottom legend exact "Ruta", "Sello", "Llegada", "Peligro". Amber ground circuit lines, cyan jump-seal discs with cyan dotted directed launch arcs, white square landing outlines, red-hatched wind danger strips. Additional concise elevation labels "0 m", "+3 m", "+6 m".
A wide COMPLETE circular lower recovery ring at 0 m surrounds a rocky central pit, so many missed leaps land on playable ground. Three large connected terraces are staggered at increasing heights 0, +3, +6 m around a central broken stepped shrine. Broad ramps connect every terrace with the lower circuit, creating alternative ways up. FOUR clearly visible magical stone jump seals provide a circuit: lower south pad to west +3 terrace, lower east pad to east +3 terrace, west terrace pad to rear +6 platform, rear top pad over a gap toward east terrace, all arcs land on generous covered landing courts with two exits. Sky-bound obsidian blades and broken temple silhouettes are distant 2D backdrop, not dozens of extra playable tiny floating islands. Violet dusk, blue-grey basalt, bone-colored friezes, desaturated hanging ceremonial cloth. TWO narrow marked side corridors show a lateral current of white dust and leaves; core landings and mandatory paths sheltered. No wind streaks obscuring enemies. The upper zone affords powerful sightlines but also two exposed approaches. One tiny black basalt quadruped leaping between adjacent ledges, one masked bone-framed ash weaver near the top, both small gameplay scale. Black pointed obsidian ammo on middle terraces, small amber ammo lower, teal ammo in exposed upper pickup sites. Bold chunky texture pixels, angular readable forms, high-quality architectural concept illustration for a feasible retro browser shooter, not photorealistic. No gun, no HUD, no medieval castles, no elaborate sci-fi mechanisms, no illegible paragraphs.
